verdict.rationale: Postman documents 'Postman Vault' for securing secrets (postman-docs-15), but there is no detail on masked-secret variables or external vault integrations (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) in the evidence, and community reports concretely claim Postman uploads/logs environment variables and secrets to its servers (postman-comm-6, postman-comm-12), directly contradicting the 'keep credentials out of shared files' promise. missing for 10: documentation of masked variable types, external vault/secrets-manager integrations, and independent verification that secrets stay local.
